title: HabitatLedger
description: A full-stack tenant advocacy platform for logging, categorizing, and tracking rental property issues with media evidence and lifecycle management. Features RESTful APIs, Multer uploads, kanban dashboard, and legal rights citations.

title: Android Rooting: Proot vs Chroot
description: A comprehensive guide on rooting Android devices and the architectural differences between Proot and Chroot. Explores kernel-level solutions like Magisk and KernelSU for high-performance Linux userspaces in Termux.

title: DockForge
description: An automation engine for Docker environments. Automatically detects system compatibility, installs Docker if missing, and orchestrates container deployments with zero manual configuration.

title: Central Hostel React Clone
description: A complete frontend clone of the Central Hostel website built natively with React. Showcases complex CSS layouts, interactive booking features, and responsive grid systems.

title: Loopring React Clone
description: An aesthetic frontend landing page mimicking Loopring's ecosystem. Features intricate CSS animations, responsive navbar, and Web3 product marketing style segments.

title: H&M UI Clone
description: A robust eCommerce storefront replica for H&M using React. Focuses on product gallery manipulation, hover states, filtering UI interfaces, and heavy layout architectures.
